citation.name: Abyssal Claims: A FAIR-aligned integration platform for deep-sea and terrestrial mining transparency

about.name: Environmental transparency across ocean and land
about.description: 50+ data layers tracking deep-sea mining concessions, global mining footprints, deforestation, biodiversity hotspots, active fires, air quality, and environmental change — connecting ocean and land data on a single interactive globe.

audience.audienceType: Environmental researchers, ocean and land policy advocates, journalists, conservation scientists, educators

isBasedOn.name: InterRidge Global Database of Active Submarine Hydrothermal Vent Fields v3.4
isBasedOn.description: A catalogue of 721 hydrothermal vent fields worldwide, classified by activity status (Active, Inactive, Extinct). Published by Beaulieu, S.E. and Szafrański, K.M. (2020) via PANGAEA.

publisher.name: PANGAEA — Data Publisher for Earth & Environmental Science

isBasedOn.keywords: hydrothermal vents, submarine vents, vent fields, seafloor, InterRidge

isBasedOn.name: ISA Deep Seabed Mining Contracts
isBasedOn.description: Authoritative GIS boundaries and metadata for all ISA exploration and exploitation contracts on the international seabed.

isBasedOn.name: OBIS Occurrence Data
isBasedOn.description: Global open-access repository for marine species occurrence data used to identify biodiversity hotspots overlapping mining concessions.

isBasedOn.name: ChEssBase — Chemosynthetic Ecosystems database
isBasedOn.description: Global database of chemosynthetic ecosystem species (cold seeps, whale falls, oxygen-minimum zones). Accessed via GBIF.

isBasedOn.name: Argo Float Programme
isBasedOn.description: Global array of autonomous ocean profiling floats measuring temperature, salinity, and dissolved oxygen. Accessed via ArgoVis API.

isBasedOn.name: Global Mining Footprints from Sentinel-2
isBasedOn.description: 74,548 mine polygons worldwide (pits, tailings, waste dumps, processing sites) derived from Sentinel-2 imagery at 10m resolution.

isBasedOn.name: Global Forest Watch — Tree Cover Loss
isBasedOn.description: Annual tree cover loss at 30m resolution (2001–2024) with weekly GLAD/RADD deforestation alerts.

creator.name: University of Maryland / World Resources Institute

isBasedOn.name: NASA FIRMS — Active Fire Data
isBasedOn.description: Near-real-time fire detection from MODIS and VIIRS satellites, updated within 3 hours.

isBasedOn.name: OpenAQ — Global Air Quality
isBasedOn.description: Real-time PM2.5, SO₂, NO₂, O₃, and CO measurements from government air quality stations worldwide.
